scope: Same binary, alternating legacy/cached shell controls, 1000 and 10000 tasks. Three valid runs per shell/size, 30 frames each. Two foreground failures interrupt perfect alternation; every valid sample retained and full attempted order preserved. Theme caching is measurement reliability, not established product speedup. Not an unobserved baseline.

summary.scope: Observed association only, not proof of GC causation. Same-thread recognized GC scopes are clipped to native build intervals and unioned, never added across nested scopes or worker threads. Timings are not an unobserved baseline.
